<function name="ScoreboardShow" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>Called when player presses the scoreboard button (<key>TAB</key> by default).</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to prevent default scoreboard from showing.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<code>
